summary: a Claude seat running on a declared account's login directory records its usage and answers again; they were refused whenever the login was not ~/.claude

replay.detail: No claim kind or replay change. Responses the seat could not record while its login was not ~/.claude stay unrecorded; new ones are recorded.

compatibility.detail: Behavior change: the Stop hook reads the session transcript beneath $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects, else ~/.claude/projects. A seat on a second or third declared account used to fail that check on every Stop, so its spend never reached st usage.

manual.detail: No manual migration. Running seats record usage from their next Stop once the new build is installed.

recovery.detail: No recovery change; an older build refuses the transcript again.
